VERDANT / 原野纪元
Original independent voxel adventure. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Rendering: Three.js r170, MIT License, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
See vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Ground diffuse overlay: Forest Leaves 02, Poly Haven, CC0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/forest_leaves_02
https://polyhaven.com/license

Voxel textures, terrain, characters, interfaces, procedural audio and game logic: original procedural work for this project.
No external runtime resource requests are required.
